metaShifts.description: Massive systematic overhaul where 20+ heroes have their innate abilities moved to basic abilities, fundamentally altering power curves and skill builds. Heroes like Anti-Mage, Phantom Lancer, Kunkka, and Brewmaster now must actively skill their former innates, creating weaker early games but potentially stronger late games. This represents the largest mechanical restructuring in Dota 2 history.

REVERSAL of 7.36c's intelligence crisis. Bloodstone spell lifesteal multiplier buffed to 4x, Dagon scaling improved, multiple intelligence heroes receive significant buffs (Lina new Combustion innate, Tinker Warp Flare improvement, Death Prophet range buffs). Combined with defensive item nerfs (Crimson Guard, Pipe, Guardian Greaves), spell damage becomes more threatening.

Systematic dismantling of team fight survivability: Crimson Guard cooldown +5s and damage block nerfed, Pipe barrier duration -2s and magic resistance reduced, Guardian Greaves cooldown +5s, Heart regen nerfed, Lotus Orb duration reduced. This amplifies 7.36c's burst damage vulnerability but from a different angle - making teams more fragile to sustained damage.

Comprehensive nerfs targeting illusion-based strategies: Phantom Lancer illusion damage gutted across all abilities (-5% Spirit Lance, -5% Juxtapose, -4% talent), Manta Style duration reduced, combined with new Illusory Armaments innate that only provides 65% effectiveness. This continues 7.36c's strength core hegemony by eliminating a key counter-strategy.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Bloodstone's Bloodpact spell lifesteal multiplier increased from 2.5x to 4x creates massive sustain potential for intelligence cores like Storm Spirit, Leshrac, and Death Prophet, enabling aggressive positioning and extended team fights.

New Persecutor innate provides scaling slow based on enemy missing mana (up to 40% at max level), synergizing perfectly with Mana Break and Mana Void to create a complete mana-drain lockdown combo that scales throughout the game.

New Admiral's Rum innate (20% damage delay, 10% movement speed) stacks with Ghostship's enhanced Admiral's Rum (35% damage delay, 15% movement speed), creating unprecedented survivability for aggressive positioning.

Simultaneous buffs to spell damage sources (Bloodstone, Dagon scaling, intelligence hero buffs) combined with systematic nerfs to defensive items (Pipe, Crimson Guard, Guardian Greaves) creates a perfect storm for spell-based burst damage.

New Septic Shock innate (10% base damage per debuff) upgraded by Aghanim's Scepter (20% damage per debuff) combined with multiple poison sources creates exponential damage scaling that can reach 60%+ damage amplification.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: Comprehensive illusion damage nerfs (-5% Spirit Lance, -5% Juxtapose) combined with Manta Style duration reduction and new Illusory Armaments providing only 65% item effectiveness creates a cascade of weakness for illusion-based strategies.

Heroes reliant on defensive items for team fight survivability (Sven, Tiny, Bristleback) suffer from systematic defensive item nerfs (Crimson Guard, Pipe, Guardian Greaves, Heart) making them significantly more vulnerable.

Shadow Amulet completely reworked with massive nerfs: duration reduced from 15s to 3.5s, cooldown increased from 7s to 18s, no longer refreshes on self-cast, destroying invisibility-based strategies and item combinations.

Both items lose all attribute bonuses, gain only health instead, with Soul Release cooldown increased from 7s to 10s and damage reduced, making the healing reduction strategy significantly weaker and less cost-effective.

Carry.explanation: New Persecutor innate provides scaling slow based on missing mana (up to 40%), Mana Break damage increased at early levels, and reworked Aghanim's Scepter creates a complete mana-drain control package that scales excellently into late game.
Metamorphosis attack range significantly increased (450/500/550/600 from 450/490/530/570) improves his already strong late-game positioning and kiting potential during his power window.

Spectral Dagger mana cost reduced, Dispersion damage reflection increased from 8/12/16/20% to 11/14/17/20%, and health regen talent buffed, providing better laning and scaling while defensive item nerfs hurt her counters more than her.

Mid.explanation: New Combustion innate deals AoE damage to enemy allies every 150 damage dealt to heroes, Fiery Soul scaling improved, combined with Bloodstone buffs and defensive item nerfs creates a dominant spell damage threat.

Crypt Swarm range increased from 810 to 900 with cast range matching wave range, Spirit Siphon can target Roshan/Tormentors, benefits heavily from defensive item nerfs making her sustained damage more threatening.
Benefits significantly from Bloodstone Bloodpact multiplier increase to 4x, providing massive spell lifesteal sustain for extended fights and aggressive positioning.

Offlane.explanation: New Prickly innate provides 10% damage and debuff amplification against enemies behind him, base damage increased by 6, and Warpath scaling improved when moved from innate to basic ability.

New Invading Force innate provides damage reduction and movement speed after teleports (doubled for Fiend's Gate), Atrophy Aura scaling improved when moved from innate, creating better team fight presence.
Skewer now deals additional damage when hitting trees/cliffs with increased damage values, providing better initiation and burst potential in team fights.

SoftSupport.explanation: New Septic Shock innate deals 10% base damage per debuff (20% with Aghanim's Scepter), Poison Sting scaling improved when moved from innate, creating exponential damage scaling potential.
Shackles Aghanim's Shard ward linger duration increased, Hex Breaks talent moved to level 15 for earlier access, Serpent Ward attack range talent buffed, improving both control and push potential.
Glimpse now deals 20/25/30/35% of distance traveled as damage, providing significant burst potential to complement his control abilities.

HardSupport.explanation: Repel now provides 60% magic resistance, Guardian Angel reworked to AoE point-target with Aghanim's Scepter providing global range and building protection, Purification gets double-cast with Aghanim's Shard.
Maledict base damage increased across all levels, benefits from defensive item nerfs making his sustained damage more threatening in team fights.
Mana Drain provides additional 15% slow when enemy has no mana, improving his lockdown potential against mana-dependent heroes.

Carry.explanation: Comprehensive illusion damage nerfs: Spirit Lance illusion damage reduced from 20% to 15%, Juxtapose damage reduced from 18/20/22% to 13/15/17%, new Illusory Armaments provides only 65% item effectiveness, destroying his scaling potential.
Whirling Axes damage reduced, Fervor Aghanim's Shard proc chances nerfed, and Berserker's Rage moved from innate to basic ability weakens his early game significantly.
Mana Shield no longer levelable and provides weaker scaling, Mystic Snake loses movement/turn rate slow and cooldown increased, despite new Gorgon's Grasp ability, overall power level decreased.

Mid.explanation: Necromastery no longer gains max souls from hero kills by default, Shadowraze stack duration reduced and mana cost increased, Requiem fear duration nerfed, continuing 7.36c's systematic weakening.
Defense Matrix damage barrier significantly reduced from 100/180/240/320 to 80/160/240/320, reducing his survivability in aggressive positions despite Warp Flare improvements.
While receiving talent buffs, the overall meta shift toward sustained damage and away from burst makes Puck's hit-and-run style less effective against tankier, more sustained damage compositions.

Offlane.explanation: Warcry armor bonus reduced, Aghanim's Shard passive movement speed removed, combined with defensive item nerfs (Crimson Guard, Guardian Greaves) makes him significantly more vulnerable in team fights.
Toss damage no longer pierces magic resistance from debuff immunity, Grow toss bonus damage significantly reduced, Avalanche talent damage nerfed, while defensive item nerfs hurt his survivability.
Thunder Clap cooldown and radius nerfed at early levels, Drunken Brawler moved from innate to basic ability weakens early game, despite new Belligerent innate providing respawn damage bonus.

SoftSupport.explanation: Acorn Shot mana cost increased significantly and bonus damage reduced, with talent bounces and armor corruption nerfed, reducing both her farming and team fight contribution.
Lil' Shredder attack count reduced from 6 to 5, with talent attacks and damage percentage nerfed, significantly reducing her late-game DPS contribution.
Rolling Thunder damage scaling adjusted unfavorably at early levels, Swashbuckle cooldown reduction talent nerfed, reducing his mobility and damage output.

HardSupport.explanation: Silent as the Grave mana cost increased, duration and bonus damage reduced, Gravekeeper's Cloak moved from innate to basic ability significantly weakens early game survivability.
Ceaseless Dirge can no longer be refreshed, Flesh Golem slow reduced, Tombstone cooldown standardized at higher values, reducing his team fight impact and sustainability.
Font of Avernus removed entirely, new Withering Mist innate only affects low-health enemies, Borrowed Time cooldown increased, reducing his overall utility and survivability.
